sections: mo2-base-style: Fusion
MO2 Revamped Dark Black
Keep text and controls readable in MO2 and plugin modal dialogs.
Keep check and radio controls visible without relying on external images.

Give numeric controls a clear, full-size stepper instead of the tiny native
   button squares that can disappear against the light background.
Main-window profile selector: a compact label and a clear, rounded field.
Main-window list options gear and its profile-aware action menu.
Make the hovered profile option visible before the click.
Keep row content anchored while selection and hover colors change.
Inline text editors must fit inside their existing item row.
Keep filter, save, and download rows fixed across hover and selection.
Keep hover feedback clear while preserving alternating mod-list bands.
Give the mod-list sort direction a clear, restrained accent.

Keep the Filters section label on the dark palette instead of the native
   light title-chip background used by the default Windows style.
A real QToolButton menu subcontrol keeps Run and shortcuts one control.

QLCDNumber paints its digits edge to edge and ignores padding; the border
   lives on the wrapper frame created by LCDNumber::useFrame().
Accent the main active-mod counter without changing other LCD readouts.
Keep wheel and keyboard scrolling, but remove the idle bar from the mod list.

Keep the model selection for MO2 actions while allowing the application to
   show its highlight only for the view that received the latest click.

Keep the last logical selection readable after focus moves to another
   control, without drawing a full-row focus rectangle.
MO2 Revamped rounded surfaces, 2026-10-04.
MO2 Revamped notification and Overwrite panels.
Refined filter sidebar and category management dialogs.

Keep combo-box popups on one rounded surface; the inner viewport must not
   paint a rectangular background over the rounded frame.

Keep the CSV heading on the dialog surface in Dark.
Standard Qt prompts and utility dialogs share the same refined surfaces.
Wizard refinements: one surface per page, content-sized paths and review.
Keep both path layouts on the same surface as their host card.
MO2 Revamped: local instance guide and deletion review
MO2 Revamped: instance switch confirmation
Hide the obsolete external help link on the instance setup intro page.
Keep a stable width while letting each wizard step use a compact height.
MO2 Revamped: executable editor
Executable editor: grouped layout and clearer hierarchy
MO2 Revamped: framed gear-action dialogs
MO2 Revamped: profile backup cards and separators
MO2 Revamped: endorsement confirmation
Mod Info empty states
MO2 Revamped first-run prompts
MO2 Revamped: unified, fixed-size instance wizard
Compact spacing for the instance wizard while keeping every control clear.
MO2 Revamped startup prompts.
Keep the advanced-path toggle visually quiet outside the path card.
MO2 Revamped profile management dialog.
MO2 Revamped: finish the executable management flow.
MO2 Revamped: Native DLL profile surfaces
MO2 Revamped: Save Isolation workspace and child dialogs
Flat icon marks for the refreshed dialog and card headings.
Main game-data workspace: refined tabs, table, refresh action, and filters.
Save browser table matches the Data workspace without changing save actions.
Downloads keeps its native list behavior while matching the refreshed tabs.
Main-window folder shortcuts with live destination hints.
Mod list workspace: one refined surface from the resizable table to its filters.
Keep every footer control compact, aligned, and responsive with the window.
Overwrite manager: keep the file workspace aligned with Data, Saves, and Downloads.
Filters dialog: group criteria, actions, and matching behavior into one workspace.
Manage Categories: one compact workspace for MO2 and Nexus categories.
Log dock and status strip: keep diagnostic rows readable without a hard selection band.
MO2 Revamped Elden Ring archive layout installer.

Audit 2026-10-11: every Settings page uses the same circular heading icons
   (General, Theme and Mod List previously drew them without the circle).

Settings pages that scroll keep the page surface (was a style sheet in
   settingsdialog.ui, which made every widget on those pages slower to style).
